heat.text:
It starts behind the eyes. By noon your hands are cold and your face is not, and the man at the oar has begun to watch you the way people watch a rope that is fraying.

"Sit down," he says. "Or do not. But decide."

choices.text: Lie down and let the day pass over you.
Keep moving. The crossing will not wait.

provenance.notes: A discrete fever scene, not a disease simulation.
